name: Navigation
use: Use for a row that opens a place, an action or a saved record: an optional icon tile, a title, line 2, and on the right a chevron, a count, Edit, or the current ✓
notUse: Not for an animal — use animal; not for an item of a task's day list — use task item

name: Tile
use: Use for the everyday verbs of More actions: one action as an icon well over one word, in a grid of two rows split evenly, a third only once More is opened (SentriUI.rowGrid). Owner, 2026-10-19.
notUse: Not for verbs that need a line to explain them (Production) — use navigation; not for places or animals.

name: Animal
use: Use for one animal in a list: the ID over a 13px context line, and on the right either its state (figure over word, weighted by level) or one line of condition tags. Designed from Farrowing room + Inspection walk, owner-approved 2026-10-11/12. The classic face (a chip under the ID, a headline, a mono meta line) stays only for the lists that still use it until they migrate.
notUse: Not for navigation — use navigation; not for a list that selects for a bulk act — use select + door; no new lists on the classic face.
states: Act now · sow died, piglets to allocate
Tags · too many for the line (+N)
Tags · long tag name folds into +N

name: Task item
use: Use for one item of a task's day list (TaskDay): due (an empty ring), ticked before saving (an ink disc), with a one-tap act beside the door, or saved (Done, then Edit)
notUse: Not for bulk selection — use select + door; not for a saved record outside a day list — use navigation with Edit

name: Select + door
use: Use when a list selects for a bulk act and opens each item: the box selects, the door opens; without a door the whole row selects
notUse: Not for open + one-tap act — use task item
